coverage_gaps: No non-FDA regulator route is available, so EMA, MHRA, Health Canada, and other jurisdictional actions cannot be systematically verified.
No citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available, limiting forward-citation expansion and independent related-record resolution beyond links exposed by PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov.
No Embase or other subject-index route is available, so conference abstracts and records not indexed in PubMed may be missed.
No preprint route is available; recent unreviewed analyses through the as-of date cannot be systematically assessed.
No dedicated journal-site or full-text route is available, so publication corrections or editorial notices absent from PubMed metadata may remain undetected.
The plan is capped at 16 query events, which may limit iterative alias expansion if sentinel queries expose unexpected terminology or incomplete indexing.
exclusion_criteria: Animal, in vitro, mechanistic-only, pharmacokinetic-only, or efficacy-only reports without decision-relevant clinical safety outcomes.
Studies outside rheumatoid arthritis when rheumatoid arthritis data cannot be separated or the population cannot qualify the target safety assessment.
Case reports, spontaneous-event summaries, narrative commentary, press coverage, or secondary webpages that cannot support a primary quantitative finding or an official regulatory action.
Reports concerning another Janus kinase inhibitor without separable tofacitinib evidence, except FDA class-wide actions that explicitly include tofacitinib.
Duplicate bibliographic or registry representations after canonical identifier matching; every query-to-record occurrence remains preserved in the retrieval ledger.
Records first made available after 2024-12-31, while later corrections discovered during status checking are flagged as post-cutoff rather than silently incorporated.
Unverified claims about correction, retraction, regulatory status, or effect estimates that cannot be traced to PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, or an FDA record.
inclusion_criteria: Human evidence concerning adults with rheumatoid arthritis exposed to tofacitinib, with separable rheumatoid arthritis results when a report includes multiple diseases.

The NCT02092467 registry record, its version history and results, the linked primary publication, and FDA safety communications or labeling actions that directly interpret the postauthorization study.

Randomized, registry, cohort, active-comparator observational, systematic-review, or meta-analytic evidence reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or mortality outcomes relevant to marketed tofacitinib.
Evidence using the trial's 5 mg or 10 mg twice-daily arms when needed to interpret dose-specific findings, protocol amendments, regulatory actions, or current marketed-use implications.
Subgroup or post hoc analyses that clarify age, smoking, prior atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, baseline cardiovascular risk, dose, latency, or generalizability.
Corrections, errata, retraction notices, expressions of concern, and linked bibliographic status records for any decision-critical publication.
Records with an online-first, issue, registry-update, or FDA effective date on or before 2024-12-31; ambiguous dates are retained for manual temporal adjudication.
English-language records or records with sufficient English metadata to determine eligibility and link the study family.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal postauthorization registry anchor by exact identifier and capture sponsor protocol identifiers, arms, amendments, results, dates, and linked publications.
Recover the primary publication anchor by exact title and capture identifiers, publication dates, publication types, related records, and indexing status.
queries.query: "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]

queries.purpose: Recover the principal FDA completed-review action by its document title and verify communication date, affected products, required warnings, and recommendations.
queries.query: "FDA requires warnings about increased risk of serious heart-related events, cancer, blood clots, and death for JAK inhibitors that treat certain chronic inflammatory conditions"

queries.purpose: Discover peer-reviewed rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across all decision-critical outcome domains without aggressive exclusion clauses.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Discover registered rheumatoid arthritis tofacitinib safety studies and verify whether other registered studies qualify or contextualize the pivotal trial.
queries.query: AREA[RareDisease]EXPAND[Term] OR (CONDITION "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND INTERVENTION tofacitinib AND (OTHER_TERM safety OR OTHER_TERM postmarketing OR OTHER_TERM postauthorization))

queries.purpose: Locate the early FDA pulmonary-embolism and mortality communications and the resulting 2019 boxed-warning or labeling action, preserving each action date.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis pulmonary embolism death 10 mg twice daily safety announcement boxed warning 2019

queries.purpose: Retrieve primary and secondary analyses that quantify cardiovascular findings and relevant effect modifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses that quantify malignancy findings, latency, cancer types, and subgroup risk.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses that quantify venous or arterial thrombosis and pulmonary embolism by dose and comparator.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence on all-cause mortality, fatal events, causes of death, and dose-specific patterns.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract] OR survival[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm the FDA evidence interpretation, class-wide scope, indication restrictions, benefit-risk recommendations, and label revisions linked to the completed trial review.
queries.query: tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death completed review boxed warning prescribing information

queries.purpose: Cross-check the sponsor protocol locator against NCT02092467 and recover registry history, protocol changes, results modules, and publication links that may be missed by the NCT locator.
Retrieve subgroup and post hoc analyses needed to qualify generalizability and identify higher-risk populations.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR "65 years"[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular risk"[Title/Abstract] OR "atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find qualifying or conflicting active-comparator observational evidence, including STAR-RA, and assess population and design differences from ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND (STAR-RA[All Fields] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, retraction notices, or expressions of concern affecting anchor or derivative evidence and require linked-record verification.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[All Fields]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Erratum[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR "expression of concern"[Title/Abstract] OR retraction[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture peer-reviewed updates, replications, meta-analyses, and later qualifying evidence through the as-of date, with online-first and issue dates checked after retrieval.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR safety[Title/Abstract])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Safety PECO as of 2024-12-31: adults with rheumatoid arthritis, especially patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, exposed to marketed tofacitinib or the doses studied in the pivotal postauthorization trial, compared with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other active rheumatoid arthritis therapies; assess major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause mortality, while linking the pivotal study registry, primary publication, FDA communications and labeling actions and qualifying the findings with subgroup, observational, correction, retraction, and temporal-status evidence.
stop_rules: Complete every planned query across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory, or record a route-specific execution failure and its effect on coverage.
Recover and cross-link NCT02092467, A3921133, the exact-title primary publication, and the principal FDA completed-review communication before stopping.
Confirm that cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis or pulmonary embolism, and mortality each have an extracted primary estimate or an explicit documented absence of a separately reported estimate.
Recover FDA actions addressing the early pulmonary-embolism and death signal and the completed-review boxed-warning or labeling response, with jurisdiction and action dates preserved.
Complete the dedicated correction, erratum, retraction, and expression-of-concern search and verify linked-record status for every decision-critical publication.
Stop citation or linked-record expansion after two consecutive completed expansion checks add no new decision-relevant study family, regulatory action, correction, or material subgroup analysis.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when provider date semantics are ambiguous and reconcile online-first, issue, registry-update, and FDA action dates.
Do not exceed 16 query events; if the cap is reached with unmet checkpoints, stop and report each unmet checkpoint as a coverage gap rather than weakening eligibility criteria.
Preserve all query-to-record links while deduplicating canonical records by PMID, DOI, NCT number, or FDA document identity; conflicting duplicate content triggers fail-closed manual adjudication.
